title: Service Deployment Guide
body: To deploy the API service, run ./deploy.sh from the project root. This pushes the app to Heroku using the Heroku Git remote. All production deploys go through Heroku dynos. Deploys are triggered manually by an engineer from their laptop; there is no automated pipeline. Roll back with `heroku rollback`.

title: CI/CD Pipeline Overview
body: All deployments are fully automated through GitHub Actions. On merge to main, the workflow builds a container and deploys it to Google Cloud Run in us-central1. Manual deploys from a developer machine are not permitted. Rollbacks are handled by re-triggering the previous successful workflow run. There is no Heroku in our stack.

title: Corporate Password Policy
body: All employees must rotate their passwords every 90 days. Passwords must be at least 12 characters and include a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols. Reuse of the previous 5 passwords is prohibited. Failure to rotate within the window results in account lockout.

title: Security Handbook — Authentication
body: In line with current NIST guidance, we no longer force periodic password rotation. Passwords should only be changed when there is evidence of compromise. We require a 14-character minimum and strongly encourage passphrases and a password manager. Mandatory periodic rotation is explicitly discouraged as it leads to weaker passwords.

title: Monitoring & Alerting Setup
body: Infrastructure monitoring is configured through Google Stackdriver. Host-level checks run via Nagios on the ops VM. Alerts are routed to the ops pager rotation. To add a new check, edit the Nagios config and restart the nagios service, then confirm the metric appears in the Stackdriver dashboard.

title: VPN Access Instructions
body: To access internal systems remotely, install the Cisco AnyConnect client and connect to vpn.corp.example.com. Request access by filing a ticket with IT. All internal tools require the VPN. These instructions were last validated for the 2021 office network layout.

title: Database Backup Procedure
body: Nightly backups of the PostgreSQL 11 primary are taken via pg_dump and uploaded to an on-prem NAS at 02:00. Retention is 14 days. To restore, copy the dump from the NAS and run pg_restore. Backups are verified manually once a quarter by the DBA.

title: New Engineer Onboarding
body: Welcome! On day one, get your Google Workspace account, request access to the GitHub org, and clone the main monorepo. Pair with your onboarding buddy to deploy a trivial change through the standard pipeline. Read the engineering handbook and the security handbook before your first week ends.

title: REST API Style Guide
body: Use plural nouns for collection endpoints (/users, /orders). Return JSON with snake_case keys. Use standard HTTP status codes. Version the API via the URL prefix (/v1). All endpoints must be documented in the OpenAPI spec before merge.

title: Incident Response Runbook
body: When an incident is declared, the on-call engineer becomes incident commander. Open an incident channel, post status updates every 30 minutes, and page the service owner. After resolution, write a blameless postmortem within 3 business days and track action items to completion.

title: Data Retention Policy
body: Customer records are retained for 7 years after account closure to meet regulatory requirements. Application logs are retained for 90 days. Backups are retained for 30 days. Deletion requests are honored within 30 days unless a legal hold applies.

title: Code Review Guidelines
body: Every change requires at least one approving review before merge. Reviews should focus on correctness, readability, and tests. Keep PRs under 400 lines where possible. Authors must respond to all comments. CI must be green before merge.

title: On-Call Rotation Policy
body: The on-call rotation is weekly, handing off every Monday at 10:00. Primary and secondary on-call are assigned via the scheduling tool. Compensation for on-call is provided per the HR policy. During an incident, follow the incident response runbook.

title: Travel & Expense Policy
body: Submit expenses within 30 days of the transaction. Meals are reimbursed up to the daily per-diem. Flights should be booked in economy unless the flight exceeds 6 hours. Receipts are required for any expense over $25. Manager approval is required before travel.

title: Release Notes Process
body: Each release must ship with user-facing release notes. Notes are drafted from merged PR titles labeled 'user-facing' and reviewed by product before publishing. Internal-only changes are omitted. Release notes are published to the status page on deploy.
